name: Ice Fang
lore: Création originale du jeu, selon le brief partiel ; pas une espèce canonique revendiquée.

assets.label: Ice Fang — corps, deux orientations
assets.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL alien mount concept for the Yautja fan-game La Longue Chasse. This is a game design, not a canonical franchise creature. Two complete side profiles SIDE BY SIDE, left animal facing RIGHT, right animal facing LEFT. Identical species/body proportions, independent opposite-side details, same scale, pure flat MAGENTA #FF00FF background and wide blank margins. No ground, shadow, scenery, text, labels, panel dividers or rider. Paint a sharp game bitmap with clear anatomy and visible joints. No saddle, harness, cargo, chains or removable armor baked onto the animal; these are separate later modules. Large polar alien quadruped with EXACTLY FOUR powerful load-bearing walking limbs and TWO additional small stabilizer limbs held out from the chest like short balancing arms, SIX limbs total. Four main broad furry claw paws all separated; small stabilizer pair visibly protrudes on either side of the chest in a distinct raised bent position, never confused with main legs. White-grey dense coat, darker naked blue-grey joint skin, broad compact head with two downward saber fangs, long thick low tail and wide snowshoe toes. No ice shards or breath cloud.
notes: Identité en revue ; nombre de membres, appuis et détails à contrôler. Selle, cavalier et effets indépendants à produire.
Inspection visuelle finale : seulement trois appuis porteurs et un stabilisateur sont lisibles par vue au lieu de quatre appuis et deux stabilisateurs. Rejet anatomique, aucun clip runtime accepté.

assets.label: Ice Fang — corps droit, six membres
assets.prompt: Use the immediately preceding Ice Fang image as the exact species reference. Redraw it as ONE single complete creature only, facing RIGHT in a strict flat orthographic side profile, centered on pure uniform MAGENTA #FF00FF. Preserve the white-grey dense fur, darker naked blue-grey joint skin, broad compact head, exactly two downward saber fangs, thick low tail and broad snowshoe paws. Critical anatomy: EXACTLY SIX limbs total. Show EXACTLY FOUR complete load-bearing walking legs with FOUR complete broad furry claw paws, plus EXACTLY TWO separate small chest stabilizer arms held raised and bent, each with its own small claw endpoint. All four walking legs, all four paws, both stabilizer arms and both small endpoints must be separately countable. Slightly offset the far-side limbs without changing head/torso from strict side profile. Every limb visibly connects at its correct root. No hidden/fused limb, stump, fifth walking leg or extra arm. Full body, tail and every endpoint in frame with generous magenta margins. Neutral standing. No second creature, reflection, divider, grid, text, ground, shadow, ice, breath, rider, saddle, harness, cargo, chains or armor. Detailed hand-painted 2D game bitmap.
notes: Inspection visuelle : quatre pattes porteuses avec quatre pieds complets et deux stabilisateurs thoraciques avec extrémités distinctes. Plaque statique en revue.
Source et copie publique conservées octet pour octet ; détourage color-key appliqué par le renderer de revue V34.

assets.label: Ice Fang — corps gauche, six membres
assets.prompt: Use the immediately preceding accepted Ice Fang six-limbed right-facing image as the exact design reference. Independently redraw the SAME creature's opposite side as ONE single complete strict flat orthographic side profile facing LEFT, centered on pure uniform MAGENTA #FF00FF. Preserve identical white-grey fur, blue-grey joints, compact saber-fanged head, proportions, thick tail and snowshoe paws. Preserve EXACTLY SIX limbs total: four complete load-bearing walking legs with four separate full paws, plus two separate small raised bent chest stabilizer arms with two small claw endpoints. All six limbs and all endpoints separately countable, correctly connected and horizontally staggered. No hidden/fused limb, stump, fifth walking leg or extra arm. Full silhouette in frame with generous margins. No second creature, reflection, divider, grid, text, labels, ground, shadow, ice, breath, rider, saddle, harness, chains, cargo or armor. Detailed hand-painted 2D game bitmap.
